description: Test 4: Block+Link mode - prefill blocks on arrival, append all links at the end
metric_note: accuracy reports the selected primary metric. strict_em_accuracy is the original whole-answer subspan EM. decomposed_pass_accuracy marks a sample correct if at least one gold answer unit or one tool-backed result is correctly covered. If enabled, llm_judge_accuracy uses an external instruction model to score semantic correctness against the user request, reference answer, and tool outputs. avg_ttft and avg_ttft_after_last_tool currently measure full generate() wall time, not true first-token latency. avg_append_calls is the average number of append_fragment() invocations per sample, not a time metric. overlap-aware metrics replay static prefill, incremental append prefill, and generation on a single compute timeline using each fragment's measured wall time and release time, so earlier append work can be hidden under tool wait.
